comments.body: Please correct the source citations for these C behavior claims. `blocksort.c:1031-1089` does not include the sorted-order postcondition at `blocksort.c:1025-1029`, and the last-column lookup is computed in `compress.c:163-167`, not in blocksort.c. Cite those locations beside the corresponding claims. The unsigned-byte comparison claim on line 11 also needs its source location (`blocksort.c:354-362`); the same claim in the test comment should cite it too.
